title: Find the hour-by-hour weather forecast
context:
You will see the weather forecast for Gainesville, Florida, on the National Weather Service website. It was saved on Tuesday, October 27.
Imagine you want to see what the weather will be like at each hour of the day.
Your task: find the link that opens the hour-by-hour forecast, and tap it.
